name: Door's Accessory
tagline: Shutter curtain, hardware and gaskets that ship with the system
blurb: Hardware is sold with the profile it was tested against. A system that passes a 25,000-cycle test only holds that number with the hinge and gasket it was tested on, so the two travel together. The same rule puts the roller shutter range here: a shutter is quoted as a set, because the operator is sized against the weight of the curtain it lifts rather than against the size of the opening.
